template: Read the needle against the printed scale: give the value it points to, rounded to the nearest tick mark, and say whether that value lies in the lower or upper half of the gauge's range. State your conclusion, justify it by describing which numbered marks the needle falls between, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: explicit semantic dependency rules plus empirical conditional-variation checks for suspected relationships; the line-order parity rule is evaluated over all 3000 source records

rounded_tick_value.visual_signal: needle intersection with the printed tick scale
rounded_tick_value.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

range_half.visual_signal: needle position relative to the scale midpoint
range_half.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
